s1.syndrome_frame: a slowly enlarging, painless, subcutaneous mass in the vulvar region
salient_findings: a firm, immobile mass in the left labia majora
histopathology showing chondroid syringoma and clear cell hidradenoma
recurrence of the mass after multiple excisions
heterogeneous, hypervascular mass on ultrasound and CT scan
key_facts: 64-year-old woman presented with a slowly enlarging mass
mass located in the left labia majora
mass was firm, painless, and immobile
mass measured approximately 7 × 4 cm
vital signs were normal
routine laboratory tests were normal
patient had a history of multiple excisions of the mass
histopathology showed chondroid syringoma and clear cell hidradenoma
ultrasound revealed a heterogeneous, hypervascular subcutaneous mass
CT scan demonstrated a heterogeneous, contrast-enhancing lesion
low-density focus in the liver suggestive of a simple cyst

Pleomorphic Hyalinizing Angiectatic Tumor of the Soft Parts
per_call: Giant Cell Tumor of the Soft Tissue

shortlist.label: Clear Cell Hidradenoma
shortlist.why_kept: histology showed lobular architecture of cuboidal cells

shortlist.label: Hidradenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: considered due to recurrence and histological features

shortlist.label: Bartholin Gland Carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: patient's history of Bartholin gland mass excision

raw.rationale: The patient's mass was diagnosed as chondroid syringoma three times due to its slow growth, encapsulation, and painless, solid nature, which aligns with the characteristics of this condition.

rejected.label: Adenoid Cystic Carcinoma
rejected.why: There is no mention of a cribriform architecture in the histology, which is characteristic of adenoid cystic carcinoma.

rejected.label: Clear Cell Hidradenoma
rejected.why: Although clear cell hidradenoma was considered after the second excision, the patient's mass was diagnosed as chondroid syringoma three times, making it a more likely diagnosis.

rejected.label: Hidradenocarcinoma
rejected.why: There is no evidence to suggest that the patient's mass was malignant or aggressive, which is characteristic of hidradenocarcinoma.

rejected.label: Bartholin Gland Carcinoma
rejected.why: The patient's mass was not located in the Bartholin gland, but rather in the left labia majora, making Bartholin gland carcinoma an unlikely diagnosis.
